title: Brick breaker paddle and ball game
when: The user wants the arcade game where a paddle bounces a ball to break rows of bricks, with lives, levels and score.
prompt:
Goal: Aimable bounces, no tunneling at speed, and levels that are easy to design as data.
Steps:
1. Logical canvas 480 by 640 scaled to fit with CSS and devicePixelRatio; requestAnimationFrame loop with dt clamped to 1/30 s.
2. logic.mjs: update(state, dt, input), circleRect(ball, rect) returning the hit side, bricks with hit points and points.
3. Bounce angle from where the ball hits the paddle (-60 to 60 degrees); constant speed, a bit faster each level; substeps so it never skips a brick.
4. Controls: pointer move, Left and Right arrows, Space to launch, P or a hidden tab pauses.
5. Lives 3, score and level in a text HUD outside the canvas; life lost and level clear in aria-live.
6. Levels as strings like "1100110011"; best score in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: wall bounce, brick damage, angle range, no tunneling at top speed.
Quality bar:
- Controls feel the same at any refresh rate.
- Ball always visible against the background.
- Pause is instant.
Pitfalls:
- Reversing both axes on every brick hit.
- Ball stuck bouncing horizontally forever.
- Game logic inside draw code.
Verify:
- [ ] Collision tested.
- [ ] HUD live.
- [ ] Buttons typed.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, game.js, logic.mjs (physics), levels.js, test.mjs.

examples.input: a brick breaker game with 3 levels
examples.output: paddle by mouse or arrows, 3 lives, bricks with 1 to 3 hits
